title: Algafusion
metaTitle: Algafusion Brand Identity — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: Case study: how Santi Universe created the Algafusion brand identity — a tiered ‘A’ mark, a Hermès-inspired orange and earthy-green palette, a signature pattern and a full stationery suite for a luxury eco-tourism brand.
intro: A complete brand identity for a luxury eco-tourism escape — built around a single, ownable mark.

hero.alt: Algafusion brand in context — a luxury desert camp at dusk with the logo and ‘The Architecture of Escape’ tagline
hero.caption: The identity in context

chapters.label: The brief
heading: Rustic posh.
Refined, and real.
text: Algafusion is a luxury eco-tourism brand offering a complete, 360-degree escape — one that fuses five-star comfort, local heritage and the raw beauty of the natural world. They needed an identity that could carry that “rustic posh” promise to international travellers: refined enough to feel exclusive, grounded enough to feel real.

The hard part was distilling an entire vertically-integrated travel model — from the foundations of the campsites to the apex of exclusive travel — into one mark that works everywhere, from a tiny name tag to signage and screens.

images.alt: Algafusion brand applied across a luxury desert camp — logo and ‘The Architecture of Escape’ tagline over a mountain lodge
images.caption: The architecture of escape

chapters.label: The mark
heading: Three chevrons.
One ownable mark.
text: We built the identity outward from a single idea: a tiered “A” icon. Three nested chevrons read at once as a mountain peak, a sheltering tent and the summit of a journey — mirroring Algafusion’s layered, ground-to-apex model.
The primary logo pairs the tiered “A” with a clean, modern wordmark and the tagline. It was drawn to stay legible at any size, in full colour, solid black or a single ink.

quote.text: The tiered ‘A’ represents our vertically integrated model — from the physical foundation of our campsites to the elevated apex of exclusive travel.

images.alt: Algafusion full-colour logo — tiered ‘A’ icon above the ALGAFUSION wordmark and ‘The Architecture of Escape’ tagline
images.caption: Primary colour logo

chapters.label: Colour & pattern
heading: Luxury, meeting
the outdoors.
text: A sophisticated, Hermès-inspired orange is balanced by grounding shades of earthy green and a warm cream. From the geometry of the mark we built a kaleidoscopic signature pattern for textiles, packaging and digital touchpoints.

images.caption: Core palette and signature pattern

chapters.label: The brand in use
heading: Every guest
touchpoint.
text: We rolled the identity out across a full stationery and digital suite — business cards, letterhead, notebook, name tags, email signature, stickers, tags and web — so Algafusion could launch with a cohesive look everywhere.
